start: Today, signed in as owner; the Birthday wish reminder is on; two members have a birthday today, one of them uses the app with the same mobile number and first name

steps.action: Open Today and wait a moment
user_sees: While the panel is still asking the server the birthday count is 0; then the tile says '1 member gets no automatic birthday wish today' with 'Send a wish'
must_not: The member who gets the automatic wish is counted
Both members counted
A count that flickers 2 then 1

steps.action: Open the tile
user_sees: Only the member without the automatic wish is offered for a message
must_not: The app member is offered a second wish

start: Today, signed in as owner; cases where the automatic wish does NOT reach a birthday member

steps.action: Two list members share one mobile number and one has a birthday today
user_sees: That member is counted as getting no automatic wish
must_not: The member treated as covered

steps.action: The app member's first name differs from the list ('Asha' on the list, 'Aasha' in the app)
user_sees: Counted as getting no automatic wish
must_not: Treated as covered

steps.action: The birthday member has no app, or an archived record
user_sees: No app: counted; archived: not counted at all
must_not: An archived member in the count

steps.action: The server cannot be reached for the switch or the app members
user_sees: Today behaves as before the feature: every birthday member is suggested
must_not: Nobody suggested
An error shown on Today

start: Today, signed in as owner; the Birthday wish reminder changes

steps.action: Switch Birthday wish off in Automatic reminders, save, open Today
user_sees: Every birthday member is suggested for a wish
must_not: Today still leaves out the app members

steps.action: Switch it on again, save, open Today
user_sees: Only members without the automatic wish are suggested
must_not: A stale answer from before the save wins over what was just saved

steps.action: A covered member leaves the gym in the app
user_sees: Within about 5 minutes that member is suggested again
must_not: The member stays hidden all day

start: Today, the AI Assistant card, signed in as owner; Birthday wish is on

user_sees: The birthday idea names only the member who gets no automatic wish
must_not: The assistant suggests wishing the member who already gets it

steps.action: Every birthday member is covered

must_not: A birthday idea with nobody in it

steps.action: Read the birthday tile and the list behind it
user_sees: Counts and the names of this gym's own members only

A mobile number of an app member shown

steps.action: Compare with the member phone at 9:30 am
user_sees: The covered member gets 'Happy birthday, <first name>! Best wishes from all of us at <gym>.' and no second gym reminder that day
must_not: A member the panel calls covered gets nothing
